kz-aboutpage: Override core. Target page for the 'About' link in site navigation.
kz-aboutsite: Override core. Display name for the site's 'About' page link.
kz-copyright: Override core. Copyright notice shown in the footer. $1 is the license name/link.
kz-copyrightwarning: Override core. Warning shown below the edit form. $1 is a link to copyright policy details; $2 is the license name.
kz-edithelppage: Override core. Target page for the 'Help' link shown in the edit toolbar.
kz-hidetoc: Override core. Text on the button that hides the table of contents. Typically a single character like '-'.
kz-showtoc: Override core. Text on the button that shows the table of contents. Typically a single character like '+'.
kz-lastmodifiedat: Override core. Last-modified line shown at the bottom of articles. $1 is the date; $2 is the time.
kz-lastmodifiedatby: Override core. Last-modified line with editor name. $1 is the time; $2 is the date; $3 is the username.
kz-logouttext: Override core. Message shown after a user successfully logs out.
kz-login: Override core. Label for the 'Log in' action in navigation.
kz-nav-login-createaccount: Override core. Label for the combined login/register navigation item.
kz-userlogin: Override core. Title of the login page.
kz-userloginnocreate: Override core. Title of the login page when account creation is not offered.
kz-logout: Override core. Label for the 'Log out' action in navigation.
kz-userlogout: Override core. Title of the logout page.
kz-notloggedin: Override core. Text shown in navigation when the user is not logged in.
kz-nologin: Override core. Prompt shown to users without an account. $1 is a link to the registration page.
kz-gotaccountlink: Override core. Link text for users who already have an account (shown on registration page).
kz-createaccounterror: Override core. Error message when account creation fails. $1 is the error details.
kz-upload: Override core. Label for the 'Upload file' action.
kz-noarticletext: Override core. Wikitext content of the page-not-found page: an apology heading, an editor-only note (search/log/edit links), guidance for visitors, and a link to {{ll|Special:Search}} pre-seeded with the page title. Styled with the skin's existing 'messagebox' class.
kz-noarticletext-nopermission: Override core. Same as kz-noarticletext, shown when the user also lacks permission to create the page.
kz-protect-dropdown: Override core. List of preset reasons in the page-protection dropdown. Each line is a reason or sub-reason.
kz-siteuser: Override core. Display string for a single site user. $1 is the username.
kz-siteusers: Override core. Display string for multiple site users. $1 is the username list.
kz-tagline: Override core. Tagline shown below the page title. {{SERVERNAME}} is the server hostname.
kz-search-nonefound: Override core. Message displayed when a search returns no results.
kz-tooltip-p-logo: Override core. Tooltip for the site logo link.
kz-tooltip-n-mainpage: Override core. Tooltip for the main-page navigation link.
kz-tooltip-n-mainpage-description: Override core. Accessible description tooltip for the main-page navigation link.
kz-accesskey-p-logo: Override core. Keyboard access key for the site logo link.
kz-accesskey-n-mainpage: Override core. Keyboard access key for the main-page navigation link. Empty string disables the access key.
kz-deletereason-dropdown: Override core. List of preset deletion reasons in the delete-page dropdown.
kz-signupstart: Override core. Introductory text shown at the top of the account-creation page.
kz-enotif_body: Override core. Full body of the watchlist email notification. Uses magic variables: $WATCHINGUSERNAME (recipient), $PAGEINTRO, $NEWPAGE, $PAGESUMMARY, $PAGEMINOREDIT.
kz-enotif_body_intro_deleted: Override core. Opening sentence of a watchlist email when a page is deleted. $1 is the page title; $2 is the editor's username (also used in {{GENDER:$2|...}}); $3 is a diff/history link. $PAGEEDITDATE is the date of the action.
kz-enotif_body_intro_created: Override core. Opening sentence of a watchlist email when a page is created. $1 is the page title; $2 is the editor's username (also used in {{GENDER:$2|...}}); $3 is a diff/history link. $PAGEEDITDATE is the date of the action.
kz-enotif_body_intro_moved: Override core. Opening sentence of a watchlist email when a page is moved. $1 is the page title; $2 is the editor's username (also used in {{GENDER:$2|...}}); $3 is a diff/history link. $PAGEEDITDATE is the date of the action.
kz-enotif_body_intro_restored: Override core. Opening sentence of a watchlist email when a page is restored. $1 is the page title; $2 is the editor's username (also used in {{GENDER:$2|...}}); $3 is a diff/history link. $PAGEEDITDATE is the date of the action.
kz-enotif_body_intro_changed: Override core. Opening sentence of a watchlist email when a page is edited. $1 is the page title; $2 is the editor's username (also used in {{GENDER:$2|...}}); $3 is a diff/history link. $PAGEEDITDATE is the date of the action.
kz-enotif_lastvisited: Override core, empty string - suppresses the 'last visited' link in watchlist emails.
kz-enotif_lastdiff: Override core, empty string - suppresses the 'last diff' link in watchlist emails.
kz-helena-disclaimers: Override core. Disclaimers text used in the Helena skin footer.
kz-userpage: Override core. Label for a link to a user's user page.
kz-wr-langlinks-label: Label shown before the list of language/translation links on a page.
kz-smw_purge: Override SemanticMediaWiki. Label for the 'Refresh' / purge button that re-parses SMW data.
kz-emailsender: Override core. Display name used as the sender of system emails.
